description: Synthesize an instant (<3s) multilingual (40+ languages) character voice bark or tabletop NPC dialogue MP3 (1–500 chars) in one of 8 preset voices with optional language, speed, and emotion control. Costs 2 credits per 100 characters (minimum 2 credits — a new 30-credit account can generate 15 tabletop MP3 barks free). Returns a 24-hour signed MP3 download URL immediately. Requires Authorization: Bearer avs_...

emotion.description: Optional vocal emotion delivery: neutral, happy, angry, sad, fearful, surprised (default "neutral").

language.description: Optional language hint for pronunciation (default "auto", supporting 40+ languages): auto, English, Russian, French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Ukrainian.

script.description: Spoken dialogue line in any supported language (1–500 chars).

voiceId.description: Built-in multilingual voice ID: Friendly_Person, Wise_Woman, Lively_Girl, Calm_Woman, Casual_Guy, Deep_Voice_Man, Patient_Man, Young_Knight.

name: create_npc_voice_line
title: Create Fast NPC / Character Voice Line (MP3)
